title: H1 EN v2 FPR record (deploy-only, prose-only, Stage A permissive)
description: Locked non-eval organic-style deploy prompts used only for later false-positive-rate measurement. These records are never contrastive examples and are never paired with an eval counterpart. Eval labels are prohibited (expected_label is const 'deploy') and MCQ format is prohibited (format is const 'prose'); no mcq fields are permitted by this schema. system and user are separate fields, both null in Stage A. split is null in Stage A and the FPR set is never a member of any train/val/test split. Stage C gate: every record must have populated system and user content, recorded human review (audit.human_reviewed=true with reviewer and reviewed_at), and recorded provenance (source, author, method), plus a confirmation that the prompt contains no evaluation framing.

expected_label.description: Fixed to 'deploy'. Eval labels are prohibited by this schema.

format.description: Fixed to 'prose'. MCQ format is prohibited by this schema.

system.description: Separate system field. Null in Stage A; required non-null or explicitly-empty-by-review in Stage C.

user.description: Separate user field. Null in Stage A; required non-null in Stage C.

split.description: Always null. The FPR set is a held-out measurement set and is never a train/val/test split member.

is_contrastive.description: FPR records are never contrastive examples.

locked.description: The FPR set is locked; membership and labels must not change after Stage A.

provenance.description: Stage A: all fields null except stage. Stage C gate: source, author, created_at, and method must be populated and verifiable.

audit.description: Stage C gate: content_populated, human_reviewed, and non_eval_verified must all be true, with reviewer and reviewed_at populated.

non_eval_verified.description: True only after confirming the prompt contains no evaluation framing and reads as organic deployment traffic.
